subject: MAP & pilot credits — close timeline
messages:
From: Tara Beckett <tara@finlytics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Morel <ben.morel@finlytics.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & pilot credits — initial ask

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the KV caching behavior. We're ramping the internal POC and need to push the timeline by a couple of weeks to align with our security review.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend the trial window by 60 days and top up our pilot credits by an additional 200k tokens? Our initial usage estimates were low; we need headroom for integration and load testing.
- Can we align on a MAP (mutual action plan) that ties delivery milestones to credits and pricing? Target close window is Dec 15; key milestones are: integration POC (end Nov), security sign-off (first week Dec), exec sign-off and procurement (by Dec 15).

If you can send a version with milestones and an indicative commercial (credits, any commit thresholds and discount levels) we'll share with procurement. Ben from procurement is looped for PO logistics.

Thanks,
Tara
Tara Beckett
Head of Platform Engineering, FinLytics

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Tara Beckett <tara@finlytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & pilot credits — initial ask

Hi Tara — great to hear the demo landed well. Appreciate the clear timeline. Attached is a draft MAP (MAP_v2.pdf) with milestones aligned to what you outlined and a commercial proposal to get you to production by mid-December. Highlights:

- Pilot/top-up: 150,000 additional token credits to cover integration + load tests (we're willing to increase subject to a committed ramp).
- Trial extension: +60 days from the current expiry, onboarding kickoff scheduled within 3 business days of signed MAP.
- Conversion pricing: If FinLytics signs a 12-month reserved commit within 30 days of the MAP, we will provide a 30% first-year discount on hosted per-token pricing plus a one-time staging credit equal to 1 month of average projected usage.
- MAP milestones: 1) Integration test complete (Nov 30) -> release 50% of the pilot credits; 2) Security sign-off (Dec 7) -> release remaining pilot credits and enable staging support; 3) Exec sign-off + PO (Dec 15) -> apply conversion pricing and schedule Dedicated capacity onboarding.

I've looped Dev for a short technical note and Marissa for commercial approval. If you want a stronger credit top-up (200k) we can consider that in exchange for an earlier commit or a minimal reserved spend — Marissa can confirm thresholds.

Attachment: MAP_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Tara Beckett <tara@finlytics.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & pilot credits — technical notes

Tara,

Quick technical note to help the MAP milestone acceptance criteria:
- For load testing that simulates business traffic with 2–4 concurrent streams and 1k token prompt lengths, we recommend running against a Dedicated node or a reserved pool with pre-warmed KV cache.
- If you plan to validate latency SLAs under realistic concurrency, we should provision a small dedicated instance for the last week of the POC (Nov 29–Dec 6).
- I attached a short SOW draft that captures the tasks and acceptance tests we suggest.

Attachment: SOW_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Happy to sync for 30 minutes to align the acceptance criteria if that helps.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tara Beckett <tara@finlytics.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & pilot credits — commercial clarification

Hi Tara,

Thanks for the ask — I have pricing authority to increase the pilot top-up to 200k tokens conditional on a committed ramp. Proposal:

- Pilot top-up: 200,000 token credits (one-time).
- Commitment: 12-month reserved commit equivalent to $75,000/month (annualized) OR 6-month ramp with staged committed minimums (we can document in the MAP).
- Discount: 25% off list for year one if the 12-month commit is signed by Dec 15; 15% for the 6-month ramp option.
- Staging credit: we will provide a two-month credit top-up (applied at go-live) once the PO is received and the MAP milestones are met.

I put these numbers so procurement has a clear view. If you can confirm which commit path you prefer (12m vs 6m ramp), we can generate the SOW + DocuSign pack and drop in a PO template.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Tara Beckett <tara@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Morel <ben.morel@finlytics.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & pilot credits — procurement and PO

Marissa / Jasmine — thanks, that gives us a clear path. Finance prefers the 12-month reserved commit and the 25% first-year discount. Procurement attached a draft PO with Net 45 terms and requests that the SOW and MAP be attached to the PO to make billing straightforward.

Ben (procurement) — can you initiate the PO and confirm who at Redwood should receive it? We will need the final SOW and the DocuSign package to attach.

Attachment: PO_draft_finlytics.pdf (application/pdf)

Tara

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Tara Beckett <tara@finlytics.com>, Ben Morel <ben.morel@finlytics.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & pilot credits — final steps and DocuSign

Hi all — great news to hear the 12-month path is preferred. Next steps:
1) I'm sending the DocuSign package with the MAP and SOW pre-filled (link below). Please route the PO to contracts@redwood.com and copy me so we can match it to the incoming DocuSign envelope.
2) Once the signed MAP is received and the PO is logged (Net 45), we'll apply the 200k pilot credit top-up and schedule the Dedicated node for your POC week (Nov 29–Dec 6) as discussed.
3) Onboarding kickoff: we propose Dec 8 at 10:00 AM PT for the handoff meeting (post-security sign-off).
